description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Your mind becomes a beacon for necrotic energy and your very presence causes organic matter and tiny creatures to wither and atrophy. When you move you leave a trail of withered grass and plants behind you and animals instinctively shy away from your path. The longer you stay in place the more things will decay in a diameter of Willpower yards around you - leaves turn brown, milk becomes sour and insects that can ee die. By touching a living or organic (plant, leather, cloth) target and succeeding with a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test you can drain its life force to sustain yourself. You cause SL Damage that ignores Armour Points (but not Toughness) to creatures and SL Armour Point Reduction to objects. You heal an equal amount of Wounds as the Damage or AP reduction you inflict. To use the ability in combat you need to pass an Opposed Melee (Brawling) Test to touch the opponent. Don't roll for normal damage. You suffer a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast} if you Fumble your Willpower Test. You may also use the same method to feed, in which case you are fed the equivalent of a good meal for each point of damage. A successful touch leaves a withered mark on a creature, and organic matter rot and crumble. Each additional time you gain this mutation you do +1 Damage.
